historical_references.reference: Ikshvi was a queen of the Vidarbha kingdom during the Mauryan Empire. She is best known for her role in the Revolt of Satakarni against the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka. Ikshvi was the mother of Satakarni and played a crucial role in the planning and execution of the revolt.

Ikshvi is also mentioned in several Hindu scriptures, including the Mahabharata and the Puranas. In these texts, she is depicted as the wife of King Vena, who ruled over the Vidarbha kingdom. Ikshvi is known for her beauty, wisdom, and piety, and is often revered as a goddess in Hindu mythology.
